scope: 24 previously stereo-unspecified products plus B18/B21 representative enantiomers and D07 salt form. Other source targets retain finalized input structures including corrected literature-R E19.
general_rules: Conventional isotropic H/C NMR in achiral DMSO and ordinary electronic-structure methods permits one representative of a pure mirror pair; this does not establish experimental absolute configuration, ee or racemic composition.

Diastereomers, tautomers, protonation states and salt/ion-pair states are separate chemical-model branches. Do not combine them using a single conformer Boltzmann sum without experimental equilibria/speciation evidence.

Provided epoxide SMILES encode the stated local face relationships. The root workflow must independently embed and verify the face tests, preservation of specified centres, and all stereochemistry by 3D roundtrip before ORCA.
18O synthesis/enrichment/configuration/ee remains prospective. Model choices and source assignments are separate metadata.

general_method_sources.supports: Conventional enantiomers have identical NMR spectra in achiral surroundings; article studies a specialized chirality discrimination method, not the present isotropic-shift model.
Use modern true-CIP labels, not legacy label outputs, for final descriptors.
